hero.headline: Oil just fell to its lowest since August. Your gas tank is next.
hero.dek: Every story on FIOPO is traced to where it lands: your fuel, your rent, your savings, your job. Here is how today's biggest story travels.

chain.label: The event
chain.text: The IEA says oil supply now tops demand for the first time since the Iran war began, with a fourth quarter surplus of about 1.7 million barrels a day.

chain.label: Crude oil
chain.text: US crude settled Monday down 3.2%, its lowest close since August 28. Brent fell 3.55% to $92.44.

chain.label: Gas pump
chain.text: AAA national average on November 16, down from $4.36 in mid October. Still the priciest November on record.

chain.label: Interest rates
chain.text: Markets price about 91% odds of a quarter point Fed increase on December 9. Cheaper oil has not changed that yet.

chain.label: You
chain.text: Saved versus mid October, about $8 on a 15 gallon fill. Borrowing costs are the part still rising.

hero.caption: Sources: AAA national average November 16; NYMEX WTI and ICE Brent settlements November 16; IEA monthly report via FinanceFeeds; CME FedWatch November 16. The chain itself is FIOPO analysis.

stories.headline: Cheaper gas will not stop a likely Fed hike. Today's retail sales report is the next test.
stories.happened: Markets kept pricing about 91% odds of a quarter point Fed increase on December 9, even as oil slid. The 10 year Treasury yield, which steers mortgage rates, closed at 5.15% on Friday.
stories.happening: October retail sales come out at 7:30 a.m. Central today. Forecasters expect a 0.2% gain after September's 0.8%. The Fed's rate sits at 3.75% to 4.00%.

could.note: Market odds from CME FedWatch, November 16. Not a FIOPO forecast.

you: Credit cards and HELOCs move with the Fed almost one for one. Pay down variable balances before December 9.
Shopping for a mortgage? Rates follow the 10 year yield, which is near 5.1%. Lock if the payment works for you now.
Keep idle cash in an account paying close to the Fed rate. A hike helps savers a little.
stories.watch: retail sales this morning, Fed minutes Wednesday.

stories.headline: Tankers are burning near Hormuz, yet oil keeps falling. Here is why.
stories.happened: Iran's navy said a fourth tanker hit a mine in 24 hours. A separate tanker was disabled near Khasab, Oman, with the crew reported safe. The IRGC says it targeted US radar in Bahrain again on Tuesday.
stories.happening: Gulf exports have recovered faster than demand, the IEA says, so the market shrugged. Iran says a regional bloc backs its plan to reopen the strait within two days under a ceasefire. The White House calls Iran's demands unacceptable.

could.note: FIOPO read for the next 30 days. Judgment, not fact.

you: Pump prices should keep drifting lower into Thanksgiving unless shipping is hit hard.
Diesel dipped below $6 a gallon for the first time since September. Delivery and freight costs should ease with a lag.
Flying for the holidays? Book now. A spike would show up in fares within weeks.
stories.watch: whether the mine claims slow Hormuz traffic, and the OPEC+ meeting November 29.

stories.headline: Nvidia reports tonight and Anthropic lists Thursday. One week will set the mood for AI stocks.
stories.happened: Nvidia closed Monday at $156.14, down 4.1%, after its CEO's sudden exit and new US limits on chip access through overseas data centers. The Nasdaq fell 2.5%.
stories.happening: Nvidia reports after the close today under interim CEO Colette Kress. Anthropic set its IPO at $70 to $78 a share, up to a $1.404 trillion valuation, with trading expected Thursday under ANT on the Nasdaq.

could.text: A steady Nvidia outlook and a calm Anthropic debut would likely lift tech into December. A weak guide could make the IPO price at the low end and extend the slide.

you: If you own an S&P 500 or Nasdaq fund, you already own a lot of Nvidia. Big earnings day swings are normal.
Up to 20% of Anthropic's shares are set aside for retail investors. First day prices can swing hard, so size any purchase as money you can afford to see drop.
Check that your retirement plan is not more than you intended in a handful of tech names.
stories.watch: Nvidia guidance tonight and where Anthropic prices Wednesday evening.

stories.headline: APEC opens in Shenzhen Wednesday. Trump and Xi meet Thursday with the trade truce on the clock.
stories.happened: The EU sanctioned nearly 50 banks and financial firms tied to Russia and approved its largest single payment to Ukraine, about €8 billion. Last week's UAE talks produced a prisoner swap but no breakthrough.
stories.happening: APEC leaders meet November 18 and 19. Trump arrives late Wednesday and holds talks with Xi on Thursday, with a three way meeting with Putin also expected. A US official says Ukraine is not on that agenda. The US and China trade truce runs to January 10, 2027.

could.text: Most likely: warm words and a truce extension, with chips unresolved. The risk: the truce lapses in January and tariffs return on electronics, toys and clothing.

you: Phones, laptops and appliances made in China are safer to buy before January than after.
Watch for any line on chips. New US export rules already hit Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Singapore and Brazil.
stories.watch: any truce extension or tariff language after Thursday's meeting.

culture.headline: Baseball's labor deal expires December 1. A lockout looks likely, and the fight is over a salary cap.
culture.happened: MLB proposed delaying a salary cap to 2028, at $258.2 million with a $180.2 million floor. Players oppose a cap. The last cap fight led to the 1994 strike.
culture.happening: Teams are expected to rush free agent signings before the deal expires. Talks are unlikely to speed up until January.
culture.could: If 60 or more games are lost, national TV deals extend a year. A spring delay is possible. FIOPO read.
you: Hold off on 2027 season tickets and travel packages until a deal is signed, or buy only with a clear refund policy.

culture.headline: GTA 6 arrives Thursday at $79.99. Preorders alone are estimated near $750 million.
culture.happened: Sensor Tower estimates about 7.7 million copies were preordered. Take-Two's CEO says preorders are far above expectations.
culture.happening: The game launches at midnight local time on November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. The Ultimate Edition costs $99.99.
culture.could: A smooth launch would lift holiday spending on consoles and accessories. A rocky one becomes a warning sign for stretched shoppers. FIOPO read.
you: The preload is about 212 GB. Check your console storage before Thursday instead of buying a drive at launch week prices.

social.headline: Oil hit its lowest since August. Gas is next.
social.caption:

Markets still price 91% odds of a Fed hike December 9 (market odds). What it means for you at fiopoin.com

evening.headline: Tankers hit near Hormuz, yet oil keeps falling.
points: Book holiday flights before a spike
evening.watch: Hormuz traffic after the mine claims, and OPEC+ on November 29.
evening.caption:
Iran's navy says a fourth tanker hit a mine near Hormuz, yet Brent fell 3.55% to $92.44 on Monday. The reason: Gulf exports recovered faster than demand. Diesel dipped below $6 for the first time since September, which eases freight costs with a lag. Our read, labeled as judgment: pump prices drift lower unless shipping is hit hard.
